content.text: The project is a bare Mathlib setup with an empty `Veribench` directory. Let me probe a few lemma names and instances I'll rely on before writing the file.

input.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/probe && cat > /tmp/probe/p1.lean <<'EOF'
import Mathlib

#check @Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow
#check @Nat.shiftLeft_eq
#check @Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod
#check @Nat.and_pow_two_sub_one_eq_mod
#check @Nat.mul_add_lt_is_or
#check @UInt8.ofNat_toNat
#check @UInt8.toNat_lt
#check @UInt8.toNat_ofNat
#check @List.forIn_yield_eq_foldl
#check @List.forIn_cons
#check @List.forIn'_cons
#check @Array.toList_push
#check @Array.toList_extract
#check @List.idxOf?
#check @List.dropWhile_append
#check @List.dropWhile_eq_nil_iff
#check @List.take_append
#synth Plausible.SampleableExt (List UInt8)
#synth DecidableEq (Except String (List UInt8))
#synth Repr (Except String (List UInt8))
#check @List.toList_take
#check @Array.toList_take
#check @List.reverse_replicate
EOF
cd /home/user/lean_project && time lake env lean /tmp/probe/p1.lean
